name: trendingzone-pk
description: Professional store for TrendingZone.pk by Ali Asad

scripts.build: npm run build-css && npm run build-js
scripts.start: npx tailwindcss -i ./input.css -o ./style.css --watch & npx esbuild index.tsx --bundle --outfile=index.js --format=esm --watch --external:react --external:react-dom --external:@google/genai --loader:.tsx=tsx --loader:.ts=ts & npx serve .

author: Ali Asad
